analysis.summary: Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY25, highlighting headwinds from volatile raw material prices and elevated input costs that impacted margins and profitability. Management outlined strategic expansions including new subsidiary formations, commissioning of a 10 MW WHRB power plant, and environmental clearance for capacity enhancements. The company maintained consistent production and sales volumes supported by its B2B customer base and infrastructure capabilities. Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported a significant increase in financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, with turnover reaching Rs. 57,665.15 lakhs compared to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Fortune of CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of aluminium industry

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that there is no substitute for CPC for making anodes in the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: There is no substitute of CPC for making anodes in the aluminium industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation and packaging industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation and packaging industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The global transition towards electric mobility and clean energy technologies is also expected to support demand for carbon materials and high-quality petroleum coke products.
demand_outlook.quote: The global transition towards electric mobility and clean energy technologies is also expected to support demand for carbon materials and high-quality petroleum coke products.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced a drop in sales volumes and pricing pressure during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: FY25 witnessed a drop in sales volumes and pricing pressure, affecting overall segment performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP).
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP).

capex_expansion.claim: A 10 MW Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory with a capital expenditure of Rs. 7,111.77 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: During the FY 2024-25, 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 and the Company has incurred Capital Expenditure of Rs.7,111.77 lakhs for the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured approval from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change for a proposed expansion project at the Haldia plant.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has got approval of Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, vide their letter dated 23rd April, 2025, for proposed expansion project of the existing plant located in Haldia, West Bengal by installation of 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant and 48,000 TPA by revamping of Old Carbon Paste Plant.

margins_costs.claim: The company noted that elevated raw material prices in FY25 could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.
margins_costs.quote: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices. These increases could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax for FY 2025-26 registered an increase of 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC and consequently the higher gross profit margin.
margins_costs.quote: Further, Profit Before Tax (PBT) for FY 2025-26 was Rs. 3353.38 lakhs as against Rs.740.53 lakhs in the previous FY 2024-25, registering an increase of 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC and consequently the higher gross profit margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2025-26 was 1,28,689.62 MT against 84,305.500 MT in financial year 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2025-26 was 1,28,689.62 MT against 84,305.500 MT in financial year 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.
orders_capacity.quote: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC and the plant comprises an area of around 30 acres with good infrastructure facilities like own railway sliding inside the plant premises itself facilitating unloading / loading of wagons, along with yard / shed to store both Raw Petroleum Coke (RPC) / Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

orders_capacity.claim: Production of Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) decreased during fiscal year 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, the Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, your Directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: During the financial year ended 31st March, 2026, the Company has spent Rs.90.77 lakhs towards Corporate Social Responsibility.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year ended 31st March, 2026, the Company has spent Rs.90.77 lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted heavy reliance on imports, especially low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and other Europe and Asian countries, affecting cost and availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company stated that the energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs during power and fuel inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that demand is tied to aluminium, steel, and battery sectors, each sensitive to economic cycles.
risks_headwinds.quote: Demand tied to aluminium, steel, and battery sectors—each sensitive to economic cycles.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that anti-dumping duties or export and import restrictions in key markets impact pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to face challenges arising from volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices.
risks_headwinds.quote:
The industry, however, continues to face challenges arising from:
• Volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices;

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry faces challenges from fluctuations in freight and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: • Fluctuations in freight and logistics costs;

risks_headwinds.claim: Environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements present ongoing challenges for the industry.
Financial Year 2024-25 presented challenges characterized by a sharp decline in revenue and profit driven by lower CPC market prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The sharp decline in revenue and profit during FY2025 was primarily due to a decrease in the market price of Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces raw material risk and supply stability challenges due to its heavy reliance on imported green petroleum coke.
risks_headwinds.quote: The CPC industry is constrained by its reliance on imported green petroleum coke, impacting supply stability and costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in crude oil prices impact the prices of both GPC and CPC.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fluctuations in crude oil prices affect both GPC and CPC prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is significantly exposed to foreign exchange risk because it imports more than 90% of its raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: The company imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers as a result of which the company faces foreign exchange risk.

management_commitments.claim: The completion of projects currently under construction (CWIP) is expected within FY 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
